entities.name: Compound Engineering Plugin
entities.how_described: 本集介绍的开源插件（可装在 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等十来个工具里，每天几十万人使用），提供 CE ideate、CE DocReview、CE brainstorm、slash LFG、CE Polish、CE compound 等命令来实现复利循环。

evidence.quote: So, I have a plugin called the Compound Engineering Plugin that you can install in whatever tool you use, Codex, Claude, CodeCursor, plus ten others.

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集贯穿的主线概念：Cora 是智能体原生的（凡是你能做的事，智能体都能做）；复盘时要能追到『哪个智能体做了哪个决定』，加智能体也是他突破早期代码瓶颈的手段。

evidence.quote: It's agent native, so that means whatever you can do, the agent can do.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
